meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 REST API 连上你的 Benchling 租户，创建和读写 DNA/RNA/蛋白等实体、库存容器、ELN 条目、workflow 任务，也能查 Data Warehouse。
howto.when: 当你提到 Benchling、benchling-sdk 或 v2 API，或要求用代码自动化实验室数据（序列、库存、ELN 等）时接管。

say.text: 用 benchling-sdk 连上我的租户，列出所有 DNA 序列
say.note: 会先读租户地址和 API key

say.text: 帮我在 Benchling 建一个容器，放进 freezer box A1
say.note: 调用 containers.create 并指定父位置

say.text: 查一下 Data Warehouse 里最近的库存变化
say.note: 用 SQL 访问历史数据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude connects to your Benchling tenant with benchling-sdk or the v2 REST API to create and read DNA/RNA/protein entities, inventory containers, ELN entries and workflow tasks, and can query the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Use it when you mention Benchling, benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or ask to automate lab data such as sequences, inventory or ELN entries.

say_en.text: Connect to my tenant with benchling-sdk and list all DNA sequences
say_en.note: Reads tenant URL and API key first

say_en.text: Create a container in Benchling and put it in freezer box A1
say_en.note: Calls containers.create with a parent location

say_en.text: Query the Data Warehouse for recent inventory changes
